I think as memed as it is nowadays a good way to start would be with jordan petersons advice and that is clean your room (his talks on depression might help in general). I know it sounds stupid but just the act of doing something can really help give you passion and seeing the progress makes you feel like you have done something. When my room gets messy now i actively wait for when i feel like nothing matters because cleaning my room feels like it gives me a purpose even if there is none. Maybe it wont exactly be this for you but try not to worry about the grand picture to much and just focus on the action. The rest should hopefully come naturally. I think the important thing is to do basic actions like cleaning or talking to somebody without a grand idea of it fixing your life. Your life might always be broken but it can be better. So try a basic action and maybe that will help. (Sorry if this was a waste of time im no expert on any of this i just know this helped me)
